page_title: MAL 2-1 ESP | Mallorca v Espanyol 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+11' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
90+10' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol).
90+9' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Sergi Darder and he is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
90+9' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) is coming onto the pitch as Urko Gonzalez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+9' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marash Kumbulla leaves the pitch and Pere Milla (Espanyol) comes on.
90+7' 2 - 1 Goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) directs his penalty into the top left corner and past Joan Garcia.
90+7' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+5' Mallorca aren't happy as the ref indicates they must retake the penalty!

90+1' Joan Garcia pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Martin Valjent (Mallorca) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom left corner, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
90+1' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Joan Garcia pulls off a superb save.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is going to take the penalty!
88' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Mallorca.
86' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Mallorca.
84' Takuma Asano will be replaced by Valery (Mallorca).
84' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) replacing Manu Morlanes.
82' The attendance for today's match is 18240.
82' Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
81' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Jofre will be replaced by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Roberto Fernandez Jaen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Espanyol).
77' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mallorca.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) for Daniel Rodriguez.
75' The Mallorca players are stunned as referee Alejandro Quintero changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
73' Celebrations by Mallorca are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
73' The players claim that Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) handled the ball and it seems they are right. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Mallorca.

71' Javi Puado (Espanyol) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

69' What a chance that is! Takuma Asano (Mallorca) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
69' Exposito comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
65' 1 - 1 Takuma Asano (Mallorca) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
64' PENALTY APPEAL by Espanyol, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
63' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.
62' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) fails to score from the penalty! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.
62' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
61' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) receives a yellow card.
61' Rough tackle by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Mallorca are awarded a penalty.
59' Espanyol are awarded the free kick. Martin Valjent (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Quintero stops the game and makes a call.
58' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

53' 0 - 1 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the right post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
53' Espanyol win a corner.
52' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
52' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Espanyol manage to earn a corner.
50' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in a cross from the corner, but Dominik Greif reads it well and gathers the ball.

49' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
48' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) makes a slide tackle, but referee Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

44' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
43' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
41' One of the Mallorca players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
40' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
39' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Espanyol win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
36' It's a free kick to Mallorca, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here. A clumsy foul by Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle.
34' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Espanyol have a free kick.
27' Mallorca are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
24' The possession of the ball – 69:31.
21' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

21' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
20' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
17' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

17' What a great touch by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Corner kick. Mallorca will have an opportunity.
16' Samu Costa (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Espanyol.

13' CHANCE! Samu Costa finds Takuma Asano (Mallorca) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
13' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Mallorca earn a free kick.
12' A cross into the box finds the head of Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) who steers it goalwards, but Joan Garcia manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
11' Mallorca are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Exposito (Espanyol) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
8' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
6' Great teamplay by Espanyol as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
